triage.note: ENUMERATED DEBT, NOT A BUG BEING FIXED. American Express FY2008 addresses Part III under ONE combined heading covering four item codes at once -- raw bytes offset 1225493 of evals/fixtures/axp-2008/filing.htm: 'ITEMS 10, 11, 12 and 13.' followed by 'DIRECTORS, EXECUTIVE OFFICERS AND CORPORATE GOVERNANCE; EXECUTIVE COMPENSATION; SECURITY OWNERSHIP ...; CERTAIN RELATIONSHIPS ...', then a ~3,000-char body. The pipeline reports all four items `missing` at confidence 0.40 with warning `expected_item_missing` and doc_status `success_with_warning`. That is an HONEST miss -- low confidence, warning fired, absence admitted -- but it is a miss: the heading is physically present and machine-readable, it simply names four codes where every heading path in src/sec10k/segment.py matches exactly one. WHAT THE CHECKS ASSERT, AND WHY `extracted` AND NOT `incorporated_by_reference`: the missing capability is combined-heading fan-out -- recognize a heading enumerating several codes and attach its one span to each named item. Feed that span to the EXISTING classifier and it returns `extracted`, not IBR, and that is CORRECT under ADR-004: the body is not pointer-only. After the proxy-IBR lead-in and its ten caption bullets it carries ~1,139 chars of substantive standalone prose -- the Corporate Governance Principles / Code of Conduct paragraph, genuine Reg S-K Item 406 code-of-ethics disclosure, which explicitly says the linked website material 'is not incorporated by reference into this report'. That is ADR-004 shape 3 (substantial real content plus pointers), ruled `extracted`; ADR-007's remainder rule implements it as IBR only when the non-pointer remainder is <= IBR_REMAINDER_MAX (300), and 1,139 > 300. VERIFY: `python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'src');from sec10k import normalize,segment;t=normalize.select_and_normalize(open('evals/fixtures/axp-2008/filing.htm','rb').read().decode('utf-8','replace'))[0];b=t[t.find('ITEMS'):t.find('ITEM 14')].split(chr(10)*2,1)[1];print(segment.classify('10',b,True))"` -> `extracted`. An earlier draft of this case asserted `incorporated_by_reference` x4 and cited ADR-004 as if it supported that; it did not, and the assertion was unreachable -- the case could never have gone green even after the capability it names shipped. Corrected 2026-08-19 in repair round 1 (PR #11 finding R1). The min_chars floor on item 10 pins that the fan-out attaches the real ~3,000-char block rather than the heading line alone. WHY IT IS NOT FIXED: fan-out is a new capability, forbidden by the T8 freeze without its own ADR -- the same reasoning that leaves ba-2003 and cvx-2015 unfixed. WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND ITSELF: this is the ONLY item-recall gap in either eval set occurring in a real EDGAR filing with content actually present to find -- the other 11 `missing` items in the dev corpus are either genuinely absent from the document (xom-2021 item 6, which FY2021 filings no longer contain; malformed-html item 1A, whose body does not survive the corruption) or sit in synthetic fixtures whose own committed expectations assert `missing` is the CORRECT answer (heading-unnumbered item 8; items-stripped-escalation items 5/6/7/7A/8/9/9A/9B). These four items are therefore the ENTIRE real-filing fallback-addressable surface that ADR-020 weighs: 4 of 989 items across both eval sets, one filing, one root cause. ADR-020 still rules the LLM fallback out, but on the escalation-ladder ground and not on a zero -- a heading-shape change produces this identical output deterministically, at $0, and closes the whole class rather than the instances a model happens to be invoked on.

provenance: T12 (2026-08-19), ADR-020; four status labels corrected in repair round 1 (PR #11 finding R1). Found while enumerating the fallback-addressable surface, by reading the committed held-out report evals/report/20260817-224952-fast.json (axp-2008-heldout: items 10, 11, 12, 13 all status=missing, confidence=0.40) against the document itself. The combined heading was verified in the RAW BYTES, not via the normalizer: re.finditer(r'ITEMS\b', raw) over the fixture returns exactly ONE hit, at offset 1225493, and it is the bold combined heading. The singular strings 'Item 10'..'Item 13' occur zero times, which is what the original held-out provenance checked; its conclusion -- 'addressed Part III without writing the item headings at all' -- overreached from a singular-form scan and is corrected here and in evals/adversarial/axp-2008-combined-heading-burned.json. The asserted status `extracted` is not a judgement call: it is what src.sec10k.segment.classify returns on this body today (see the triage note's one-line repro), so the four checks encode exactly what the named missing capability would deterministically produce, and the case's green-contract is reachable. The three hygiene checks are bookkeeping, as in cvx-2015-internal-pointer.json. Fixture moved to evals/fixtures/axp-2008/ when the held-out case was burned (ADR-020 section g). If these ever go green the runner says 'NOW GREEN -- promote it'.
